description: The model job: it reads the model files of the project and writes the companion files and the shared model folder.

sources.description: Model files and folders of the job. Each lies inside the folder of golem.yaml. Without it the job scans that folder.

suffixes.description: File-name endings of a model file. Each starts with a dot and ends in .ts, .mts or .cts. The default is .model.ts and .models.ts.

output.description: The folder that holds the shared model files. The default is src/generated/models.
